lead.description: a sample in which people who already have the outcome are included more readily than people who do not

overview_sentence: A [case-control study](articles/case-control-study.qmd) samples people according to the outcome and then compares exposure.

self_checks.title: Odds ratio
self_checks.prompt: Cases are 24 exposed and 16 unexposed. Controls are 10 exposed and 30 unexposed. What is the exposure odds ratio?

self_checks.title: Extra controls
self_checks.prompt: Controls become 10 exposed and 34 unexposed, and the cases stay 24 and 16. What is the odds ratio?
